section: §8.3 FBI Laboratory — examiner Amanda Bakker (item table, lines 292–302); §8.4 findings 1–4 (lines 304–309); §9 nulls 2, 5 and 6; §16 SINK rows for FBI item 54 and for the second major contributor
changed_since: The 'aligned, not was' flag is now stated twice — in the item-7 table row and again at §9 item 2 — and §9 item 2 has grown a second limb it did not plainly have: the two FBI likelihood ratios were read in by Sgt. Faumuina on Day 2 BEFORE the examiner was called, were never uttered by the examiner, and were disclaimed by her under oath as identifying either man as a source. §8.4 finding 1 has swollen into a single paragraph carrying a re-run scoped null (2026-09-14), an explicit rescoping from 'was ever computed' to 'appears anywhere on this record', a PROVISIONAL flag on its analytic home (DNA-E01 §3), a phase-label flag retracting an inherited 'on redirect', and a direction-and-size guard that may not be softened. Item 54's result has been moved to the SINK as UNVERIFIED with the narrowing 'a missing figure, not a null result', which is stricter than the table's 'no result stated'. Two narrowings recorded at §ES have NOT reached the sections carrying this chain: §ES finding 3 records that 'unqualified' is too strong and that the 'on the State's own examination, not only on cross' framing is unsupported because both DNA analysts were defence witnesses — while §8.1 still reads 'unqualified and unrebutted by anyone' and §8.4 finding 3 still reads 'on the State's own examination'.

steps.step: S1 — The examiner's own language about Robinson on the towel is alignment, not identity
premises: FBI item 7, the towel from around the rifle, produced a full profile with two contributors, one of whom is Twiggs, in proportions of 5% and 95%.
The examiner said Twiggs' profile 'aligned with the 5% contributor' and Robinson's 'aligned better with the 95% contributor'.
Her verb is 'aligned', not 'was'.
steps.conclusion: The examiner's statement about Robinson on the towel is not a statement that his DNA was the 95% component.
implicit_premises: That 'aligned' and 'aligned better' are deliberately weaker than 'was' in this examiner's usage — she was never asked about the verb on this record, so the distinction is the file's reading of her word choice.
That a machine transcript records the verb accurately, and that 'aligned better' is a comparative between candidate references rather than a degree of match.
That the witness's choice of verb, rather than the substance of a mixture deconvolution, determines what the testimony supports.
That 'Robinson's profile' means a known reference profile taken from him, and that the comparison was to that reference.

steps.step: S2 — The only other FBI statements naming Robinson are ratios their author disclaimed
premises: Two likelihood ratios in the FBI report name Robinson, on the towel and on the screwdriver.
They were read into the record on Day 2 by Sgt. Faumuina, before the examiner was called.
The examiner herself never uttered those figures.
As the report's author she disclaimed under oath that they identify either man as a source.
steps.conclusion: The FBI's statements about Robinson are of exactly two kinds — hedged alignment language and author-disclaimed ratios — and neither is a source attribution.
implicit_premises: That the enumeration is exhaustive: that no third kind of FBI statement about Robinson exists on this record. State's Exhibit 31 and the FBI case file of 379 or more pages are unbanked and have never been read, so the enumeration is bounded to the transcripts.
That the author's characterisation of her own figures controls their meaning, while a non-author's reading of the same figures adds nothing.
That 'never uttered' rests on a search of her examination and that such a search would catch a paraphrased or rounded restatement.
That a disclaimer covering 'either man' covers Robinson specifically and is not confined to the question actually put to her.

steps.step: S3 — The conditioning problem: the ratios never test the elimination donor's presence
premises: The two FBI figures are ratios between hypotheses that both place Lance Twiggs among exactly two contributors.
The examiner stated affirmatively that when she calculated the statistic for Robinson she used Twiggs as an elimination.

A purposive search of the whole Bakker examination, re-run 2026-09-14 under both readings of the U+FFFE split, found no Robinson figure computed without Twiggs, no counterfactual request forms, and zero hits for the stems inflat-, exaggerat- and overstat-.
The scope of that null is the transcripts; Exhibit 31 and the FBI case file are unread.

The witness's unrebutted answer was that for a major contributor the three-to-two change 'doesn't change the likelihood ratio of that major contributor by much', while conceding that it does change it; her answer opened 'It depends'.
steps.conclusion: Neither ratio tests whether Twiggs is present, neither yields a source attribution for anyone, and the record is silent on the direction and size of any effect on Robinson's figure.
implicit_premises: That a likelihood ratio whose two propositions share a contributor cannot test that contributor's presence — a statistical proposition the file asserts and homes at DNA-E01 §3.5, which is flagged as never cleared by a verification cycle.

That a defect in what the ratio tests about Twiggs bears on what it supports about Robinson; the step moves from 'never tests Twiggs' to 'no source attribution for anyone' without an intervening premise.

That an exhaustive search for counterfactual phrasings would have caught any recalculation discussion however worded, and that a transcript null about the courtroom bounds what the laboratory did — the passage states this limit and then relies on the null anyway.

That the examiner's practice claim ('elimination samples are different') being unrebutted is compatible with it being unverified — the file says so explicitly, but the step still uses the unrebutted answer to bound the magnitude question.

steps.step: S4 — The contributor count under the alignment statements is a subjective call
premises: The number of contributors is the examiner's own determination, entered as an input to the software.
On FBI item 7 that number moved from three to two.
The two-person call is not independent of the elimination donor's introduction (D-54).
steps.conclusion: The mixture deconvolution on which the towel alignment statements rest is analyst-dependent, not machine-determined.
implicit_premises: That 'not independent of' the elimination donor's introduction is being offered as a reason to discount the result, while the file elsewhere records that the direction and size of any effect are unknown — the step supplies a direction the record does not.

That a subjective determination is for that reason less reliable, rather than a routine and accepted analytical judgment; the file elsewhere records that whether this is ordinary or anomalous practice is a technical question it has NOT verified.
That the three-to-two change and the elimination donor's introduction stand in the order the inference needs.

steps.step: S5 — Two items produced no stateable result at all
premises: FBI item 9, a backpack, was processed for DNA and no DNA result was ever stated; two competing in-laboratory attributions exist, neither adopted by the examiner.
FBI item 54, swabs of swiped finger areas, has no result stated and was entirely consumed.
§16 labels item 54's result UNVERIFIED and records that it is a missing figure, not a null result.
steps.conclusion: Two of the FBI items carry no result this record can state, and neither absence may be read as a negative finding.
implicit_premises: That a result never stated in testimony is a result the record cannot supply — not that none exists; the SINK row says this for item 54 but the §9 null ('No result was ever stated for FBI item 9') is written in the same absolute form for the backpack without the same qualifier.
That the examiner's non-adoption of the two in-laboratory attributions is meaningful rather than a matter of what she was asked.
That the search establishing 'never stated' covers the whole of the relevant testimony, including any statement made in other witnesses' examinations.

steps.step: S6 — One internal contradiction, registered rather than resolved
premises: FBI item 8, the screwdriver handle area, produced a partial degraded profile showing a 'ski slope' effect, with two contributors one of whom is Twiggs.
The proportions are given as 11% and 89%.
The witness answered '79%' later, and the 79% variant is confirmed on the record.
11 plus 89 is 100; 11 plus 79 is 90.
The conflict is carried as D-57 and is not resolved.
steps.conclusion: The record carries an unresolved inconsistency in the item-8 mixture proportions, which the file registers rather than adjudicates.
implicit_premises: That both figures refer to the same quantity of the same item, so that they genuinely conflict rather than describing different components or different items.

That a two-contributor proportion pair must sum to 100, so one of the two figures must be wrong — which assumes no unreported third component, no rounding convention and no transcription error in the spoken number.
That the arithmetic does not by itself resolve which figure is correct — the file draws no conclusion from the sums, so the arithmetic is displayed without doing work.

steps.step: S7 — Consumption runs through the whole FBI set
premises: The six swabs from the north-east corner of the Losee building produced no DNA at all — 'There was nothing for me to compare to' — and were entirely consumed.
FBI item 54 was entirely consumed with no result ever stated.
FBI item 55, the stairwell railing, was two swabs combined, returned 'more than five individuals, so I could not provide a conclusion', and was entirely consumed.
§8.4 finding 4 states that consumption forecloses re-testing.
steps.conclusion: The FBI items that produced nothing usable are gone, and re-testing them is foreclosed.
implicit_premises: That 'entirely consumed' leaves nothing anywhere for any re-examination — extracts, amplified product and electronic data are not addressed.

That consumption is a loss of the same kind for an item that produced no DNA as for one that produced a profile; for the six Losee swabs the premise that re-testing would have added something is unstated.

That combining two railing swabs into one sample, and the resulting five-plus contributors, is attributable to the sampling rather than to the surface — the file records the fact and leaves the inference open.
That the consumption testimony reached each of these items individually rather than being a general statement.

steps.step: S8 — The examiner declined the premise that the railing was where the suspect touched
premises: Counsel put to her that the railing was 'where the suspect touched'.
She answered: 'As far as I know, they were swabs from a stairwell.'
steps.conclusion: The railing sample carries no suspect-location significance on this record.
implicit_premises: That a witness's refusal to adopt counsel's characterisation removes it from the record, rather than leaving it a contested proposition another witness might support.

That 'as far as I know' bounds the answer to her own knowledge as an analyst who receives swabs, and that a laboratory analyst is not the witness who would know the collection location — which, if true, means her answer is silent on the question rather than adverse to it.

steps.step: S9 — The aggregate: what the FBI item account supports
premises: The examiner's own language about Robinson is 'aligned', not 'was' (S1).
The only other FBI statements naming him are ratios their author disclaimed as source identifications (S2).
Those ratios place Twiggs in both propositions and so test nobody's presence (S3).
The contributor count beneath them is a subjective, non-independent call (S4).
Two items produced no stateable result (S5), one item's proportions are internally inconsistent (S6), and the items that produced nothing usable are consumed (S7).
steps.conclusion: No analyst attributed any DNA to Robinson as its source; the FBI item account supports alignment language, not identity, and much of the set supports nothing at all.
implicit_premises: That the listed items and statements exhaust the FBI's output about Robinson on this record — the FBI report itself (Exhibit 31) and the case file of 379 or more pages are unread, so the account is an account of the TESTIMONY, not of the laboratory's work.
That the absence of a source attribution in testimony implies the laboratory made none.

That a hedged verb, a disclaimed ratio, a subjective contributor call, two missing results and one arithmetic conflict cannot in combination amount to more than their weakest member — the step aggregates limitations without asking what the surviving positive content is.

That the whole is being offered as a scoped statement about this record rather than as a finding about the evidence, which is how §ES and §9 restate it in unscoped form ('No analyst attributed any DNA to Robinson as its source').

chain_name: Findings 3 and 4 — large in volume, narrow in bearing, and the strongest-sounding numbers most constrained
section: §ES · Executive summary, findings 3 and 4 (carried at §8.1, the §8.2 Exhibit 30 table and its four cautions, and §8.4 structural findings 3–4)
changed_since: Finding 4 has been reversed in direction since its plainer form: it formerly concluded the capped ratios were 'the most constrained' numbers; it now states that a cap conceals how LARGE a value is, that the ten capped entries sit more than two orders of magnitude above the single uncapped figure, and that the surviving claim is only 'least RESOLVED.' Finding 3 has been narrowed twice: 'unqualified and unrebutted by anyone' became 'the FBI examiner qualified the timing answer,' and 'the single most consistent proposition in the entire body of evidence' was withdrawn as a corpus-wide ranking and replaced with 'both laboratories' analysts agreed and no located record item contradicts it.' A whole step was dropped — 'on the State's own examination, not only on cross' — after the posture correction that both analysts were defence witnesses. NOTE for decomposition scope: §8.1, the finding's own home paragraph, still carries BOTH withdrawn phrases verbatim ('unqualified and unrebutted by anyone' and 'the most consistent proposition in the entire body of evidence'), so the same chain exists at two different scopes in the current document; the steps below decompose the §ES (narrowed) form.

premises: The ATF analyst and the FBI examiner each testified about the DNA results naming Robinson.
Both stated that they cannot say what action deposited any DNA.
Both stated that they cannot say when any DNA was deposited.
steps.conclusion: The record contains no analyst statement of the depositing action or the time of deposition for any DNA item.
implicit_premises: The two analysts were answering the same question, so their two answers express one shared proposition rather than two separate limited ones.
No witness other than these two analysts addressed deposition action or timing anywhere in the five-day record.
The inability is a limit of the method, not merely of what these two witnesses happened to be asked.
'Cannot say' as spoken in testimony means 'the record does not establish', rather than 'this witness declined to state'.

premises: An earlier form of this finding described the analysts' agreement as 'unqualified.'
The FBI examiner in fact qualified her timing answer, agreeing that she could not give the precise action or the exact time.
The finding's headline sentence still reads that neither analyst can say what action deposited any DNA, or when.
steps.conclusion: The finding is retained at its original scope, with the qualification recorded alongside it rather than folded into it.
implicit_premises: 'Cannot give the precise action or the exact time' and 'cannot say what action, or when' are the same proposition for this finding's purposes.
The qualification does not leave open that the examiner could give an approximate action or an approximate time — which is the reading the words 'precise' and 'exact' most naturally invite.
Recording a qualification beside an unqualified headline is sufficient to keep the headline in use; the caveat that names the narrowing is treated as having performed it.

premises: Both DNA analysts were called as defence witnesses.
The State's examination of a defence witness is the cross-examination.
An earlier form claimed the agreement was obtained 'on the State's own examination, not only on cross,' which that posture makes unavailable.
steps.conclusion: The claim that the agreement survived the State's own examination as something distinct from cross-examination is dropped.
implicit_premises: The evidential standing of the agreement is unchanged by the analysts having been the defence's own witnesses.

A proposition elicited from witnesses called by the party it favours is not discounted for that reason — the document removes the step that was meant to supply independence and supplies no replacement for it.
The corrected posture only subtracts a supporting step and does not affirmatively cut against the finding.

premises: An earlier form called the proposition 'the single most consistent proposition in the entire body of evidence.'
No banked artifact in this library can support a corpus-wide ranking, and this file is not positioned to make one.
The replacement claim is that both laboratories' analysts agreed on the proposition and that no located record item contradicts it.
steps.conclusion: The proposition stands as a claim about what the located record contains, rather than as a ranking of propositions.
implicit_premises: The located portion of the record is large and representative enough that the absence of a contradicting item within it is meaningful.

'No located record item contradicts it' is not itself a covert corpus-wide claim, although it is a negative assertion about the whole of the located corpus — the same class of claim the ranking was withdrawn for being.
The search that produced 'no located record item' had a scope adequate to the proposition; that scope is not stated at this sentence.

premises: The DNA evidence naming Robinson comprises many items across two laboratories and at least two reports.
None of it establishes what action deposited any DNA, or when.
No analyst attributed any DNA to Robinson as its source; every ATF statement is a likelihood ratio between two hypotheses.
steps.conclusion: The forensic record naming Robinson is large in volume and narrow in what it can bear.
implicit_premises: 'What it can bear' is exhausted by source attribution plus deposition action and timing; no other inference the volume might support is considered.
Many items each narrow in bearing cannot aggregate into a wider bearing — the number and spread of separate locations is treated as carrying no independent inference.
The items counted toward 'volume' are the same items whose bearing is narrow, so the two halves of the sentence range over one set.
'Volume' and 'bearing' are being used as independent dimensions rather than as two descriptions of the same evidential weight.

premises: Ten of the eleven ratio-bearing ATF items in State's Exhibit 30 are reported as 'at least one trillion times more likely.'
The laboratory will not report a value higher than one trillion.
One item, the optical accessory (1.9), carries a reported value of 6.28 billion.
steps.conclusion: The 'at least one trillion' entries are reporting floors set by laboratory policy, not measured values; only the 6.28 billion figure is an actual reported measurement.
implicit_premises: Every 'at least one trillion' entry arises from the same reporting policy, rather than some being computed bounds particular to their own data.
The record establishes the reporting cap as a policy, rather than the library inferring policy from the repetition of an identical number across items.
The 6.28 billion value fell below the cap because of the data, not because a different reporting rule applied to that item.

premises: A floor of 'at least one trillion' states that the true value is one trillion or greater.
One trillion is more than two orders of magnitude above 6.28 billion.
steps.conclusion: The capped entries stand for ratios at or above a value far larger than the single uncapped figure.
implicit_premises: The capped and uncapped figures are quantities of the same kind and so can be compared by magnitude — though the table shows them as ratios between different hypothesis pairs with different numbers of unknown contributors (major component + 2, + 3, + 4, and so on).
A floor licenses describing the values as 'far larger' rather than only 'at least' the cap; nothing in the record bounds any capped value from above, so the comparison is anchored at one end only.
The arithmetic step (1 trillion ÷ 6.28 billion ≈ 160, i.e. slightly over two orders of magnitude) is left unstated.

premises: An earlier form of this finding called the capped ratios 'the most constrained' numbers.
A cap conceals how large a value is, not how small.
steps.conclusion: The earlier framing read the constraint backwards, and the finding is corrected.
implicit_premises: 'Constrained' in the earlier form meant constrained in magnitude, not constrained in what the number can establish — the correction depends on which sense the withdrawn word carried, and the document does not settle it.
The claim that the error 'ran against the State' is established rather than inferred from the direction of the correction.
The claim that it 'survived four source-checking passes because every figure had been transcribed correctly' is a claim about why those passes missed it, made by the same file that ran them.

premises: Above the reporting cap, the magnitude of the ratio cannot be recovered from the record.
The capped entries nonetheless state a floor.
steps.conclusion: The ten capped entries carry no resolution, not no information.
implicit_premises: Resolution (precision about magnitude) and information (evidential weight) are separable properties of a likelihood ratio.
An unrecoverable magnitude does not reduce the evidential weight of the floor that is stated.
A floor set by a reporting convention is informative about the evidence, rather than informative only about the laboratory's reporting practice.

premises: The numbers that sound strongest on their face are the ones reported as 'at least one trillion.'
Those are the same numbers whose magnitude cannot be resolved.
The one number whose value is actually reported, 6.28 billion, sounds weaker.
steps.conclusion: The strongest-sounding numbers are the least resolved.
implicit_premises: Apparent strength tracks the face value of the figure as written, for whatever audience the finding has in mind.
The comparison population is the eleven Exhibit 30 items; the two Exhibit 33 items and the two FBI ratios are numbers on the same record but sit outside the comparison the superlative ranges over.
A comparative superlative ('least resolved') is supportable from a two-class partition of ten items against one.

premises: The trigger swab (item 1.3) was taken together with the trigger guard.
The analyst said she would not be able to say where the DNA came from.
That item carried at least four contributors, possibly more, with degradation, and the major profile was the most degraded.
steps.conclusion: The trigger ratio cannot be attributed to the trigger itself.
implicit_premises: A ratio computed on a combined swab cannot be apportioned between the two surfaces swabbed.
Degradation of the major profile bears on the reliability of the resulting ratio, by a mechanism the document states nowhere.
The contributor count and the degradation are separate limits that add to each other rather than describing one underlying problem.
These limits on item 1.3 bear on the finding's headline about 'the strongest-sounding numbers,' i.e. the trigger figure is among the capped ones.

premises: Five of the number-to-location mappings rest on Sgt. Faumuina's Day 4 reading alone.
She is a non-expert witness reading aloud from State's Exhibit 30.
This library has never read that exhibit.
Day 5 corroborates the set of locations but not which number goes with which.
steps.conclusion: Those mappings are single-sourced and graded Medium-high, below the set of locations, which is graded High.
implicit_premises: Day 5's corroboration of the set genuinely fails to corroborate the pairings — a negative claim about what Day 5 contains.
A non-expert reading aloud is a distinct and lower reliability class than the examiner's own recitation of her report.
No other route to the pairings exists anywhere in the record or in the banked artifacts.

The §ES form expresses this as 'five of the seven number-to-location mappings' while §8.2 names five ITEMS (1.1, 1.2, 1.5, 1.6, 1.9) against seven CALCULATIONS — the step assumes the item count and the calculation count can be written as one fraction.

premises: The numbers naming Robinson are numerous and large-sounding.
Their magnitudes above the cap are unrecoverable, most of their item-to-location pairings are single-sourced, and the trigger figure cannot be apportioned.
No analyst attributed any DNA to Robinson as its source, and neither laboratory's analyst can state the depositing action or time.
steps.conclusion: The volume and apparent magnitude of the forensic numbers do not extend what the forensic record establishes about Robinson.
implicit_premises: Apparent magnitude and evidential reach are independent, so a very large ratio adds nothing to reach.
Findings 3 and 4 range over the same body of evidence and can therefore be conjoined into a single conclusion.
The limits identified across the two findings are the complete set of limits bearing on reach — the conclusion is stated as if exhaustive.
A likelihood ratio's failure to attribute a source is a limit on the evidence rather than a property of the statistic being correctly reported.

chain_name: The window-print exclusion converted into a sequence question
section: §8.5 · Latent prints — and the exclusions (the '⚖ BOTH DIRECTIONS, LOGGED' bullet, limb 'Away from the State'), carried in compressed form at §ES finding 5 and §9 item 4
changed_since: The plainer earlier form was a one-directional exculpatory bullet: the drop point produced nothing inculpatory by two independent forensic routes. Five layers have been added since. (1) The FBI inconclusive on the same three prints, so the exculpatory reading 'does not travel.' (2) Sgt. Faumuina's 'did not touch' testimony, which makes the exclusion inert rather than exculpatory. (3) Limits on THAT testimony, including a P5 narrowing from 'un-cross-examined' to 'the defence did not cross-examine on the determination itself.' (4) The P8 caveat that three excluded prints is a numerator with no denominator. (5) The newest layer, and the one the chain is now named for: the date null converts the weight question into a SEQUENCE question, and the conclusion is downgraded to 'possible but not established either way.' The weight assessment itself has also been demoted — it is now labeled as this library's own assessment carried by CR-E19 F-4, second-hand and provisional. NOTE: the §ES finding 5 copy of this chain is truncated mid-sentence ('Nor across the countervailing testimony: Sgt.'), so the testimony limb appears there by name only; the steps below decompose the full §8.5 form.

premises: A stipulation of the parties records that Robinson was excluded as the source of all three comparable window prints (11B, 11C, 11D).
All six swabs from the north-east corner of the Losee building were consumed and produced no DNA at all.
The window and the north-east corner are the drop point.
steps.conclusion: The drop point produced nothing inculpatory by two independent forensic routes.
implicit_premises: Latent-print comparison and DNA analysis are independent routes, so a negative on each is two findings rather than one.
A consumed swab yielding no DNA is a negative result about the surface, not a failed or exhausted test.

The absence of an inculpatory result at the drop point is the kind of fact that points 'away from the State' at all — i.e. that an inculpatory result was expected there if the State's account is right.

premises: The three prints described are the comparable ones.
The total number of latents observed on the window is never stated on the record.
The residual 'other prints' is never counted.
steps.conclusion: The exclusion covers three prints and cannot be expressed as a share; no file may write 'three of N.'
implicit_premises: The three comparable prints are the ones that would carry the toucher's identity, so the uncounted residual bears on nothing — this is what lets the exclusion keep any exculpatory reading at all after the denominator is conceded missing.
Whoever determined which prints were 'comparable' applied criteria the record does not state, and those criteria are treated as neutral.
A caveat forbidding the fraction leaves the underlying exculpatory inference intact.

premises: The same stipulation records that the FBI's subsequent examinations of these three prints were inconclusive.
An inconclusive is neither an identification nor an exclusion.
The word 'identification' appears nowhere in the hearing's print record.
steps.conclusion: The exculpatory reading of the window exclusion does not travel across the FBI result.
implicit_premises: A later inconclusive on the same prints qualifies or partly displaces the earlier exclusion, rather than simply sitting beside it as a second laboratory's separate outcome.
'Subsequent' means the FBI examined the same physical latents, not new lifts or different prints.
An inconclusive from a second laboratory is evidence bearing on the first laboratory's exclusion, rather than evidence only about the second laboratory's own capability on degraded material.
The direction of the non-travel is one-way: the FBI result is allowed to weaken the exclusion but the exclusion is not allowed to weaken the inconclusive.

premises: Sgt. Jennifer Faumuina testified on direct examination.
She had obtained higher-resolution footage directly from UVU, as against the command-post copy she described as 'pretty grainy.'
Asked what her determination was, she answered: 'We determined that he was not or he did not touch it.'
steps.conclusion: The State's own witness testified that the person did not touch the window.
implicit_premises: 'It' in her answer refers to the same window from which the three latents were lifted.
The higher-resolution footage covers the relevant moment, so a determination from it is a determination about whether contact occurred.
An investigator's determination from video is the kind of claim that can bear on whether prints were deposited on a surface.
'We determined' reports a conclusion the witness herself holds, rather than a team conclusion she is relaying.

premises: If the person did not touch the window, no print of his was deposited on it.
Robinson was excluded as the source of the three comparable prints that were on it.
steps.conclusion: An exclusion on prints nobody is believed to have left proves little either way.
implicit_premises: The prints that were on the window are therefore attributable to unrelated persons at unrelated times.
The exclusion's only probative route was 'the toucher's prints are on this window and they are not Robinson's' — no other exculpatory route is considered.
The determination, if true, makes the exclusion evidentially inert rather than merely reducing its weight; 'proves little either way' asserts near-total neutrality.
The document's own framing 'nobody is believed to have left' silently converts one witness's determination into a general belief state.

premises: The determination is an investigator's visual review of video.
It is not an examiner's analysis.
The defence did not cross-examine on the determination itself.
steps.conclusion: The 'did not touch' testimony has its own limits, which cut back in the opposite direction.
implicit_premises: An investigator's visual determination sits in a lower reliability class than an examiner's analysis, by a standard the document does not state.

The absence of cross-examination on the specific point reduces the testimony's standing — although the document does not say which way an untested point cuts, and elsewhere in this library an un-cross-examined answer is described as 'unrebutted, which is not the same as verified.'
The limits on the testimony reduce its power to neutralise the exclusion without restoring the exclusion's original exculpatory weight.

premises: On the same cross-examination the defence established that the windows were processed on 9/11, 'the next day' after Faumuina first reviewed video of the suspect running toward the jump area.
The same cross established that the latents were taken as a genuine test: 'because you wanted to rule out whether the suspect had touched that window?' — 'Yes.'
steps.conclusion: At the time the latents were lifted, the question whether the suspect had touched the window was still open to the investigators.
implicit_premises: The video Faumuina first reviewed — the one that dates the processing — is the grainy command-post copy, not the higher-resolution UVU footage; the document never states this, and the whole sequence argument depends on it.
A ruling-out test implies the investigators had not already reached the 'did not touch' determination when they lifted the prints.
'The next day' anchors the print processing to 9/11 rather than to some other reference date.

premises: No date appears anywhere on this record for when the higher-resolution UVU footage was obtained.
A search of the banked .txt artifacts under both U+FFFE readings, re-run 2026-09-14, returned no hit that dates the acquisition.
steps.conclusion: The record cannot place the 'did not touch' determination in time relative to the print exclusion.
implicit_premises: The determination's date is the date the better footage was obtained, or later — the determination could not have been reached on the grainy copy.
The scope searched (banked .txt artifacts) is coextensive with 'this record', so a null there is a null on the record; the search excludes any non-.txt artifact, including scans with no text layer.
If an acquisition date existed on the record, it would settle the sequence.
The null about the acquisition date is CR-E19's, re-checked here — so the scope statement is inherited as well as re-run.

premises: The two candidate orderings are: the exclusion first and the 'did not touch' determination later, or the reverse.
No date fixes either ordering.
steps.conclusion: The sequence — exclusion first, 'did not touch' later — is possible but not established either way.
implicit_premises: The sequence is the thing that matters — i.e. the ORDER of the two events would change how the 'did not touch' testimony bears on the exclusion. The document asserts this by structure and never argues it; the unstated reason appears to be that a determination reached after a negative print result could be an accommodation to that result rather than an independent finding.
The two orderings exhaust the possibilities — the determination could also have been contemporaneous, reached in stages, or revised after being first formed.
A sequence that is 'possible but not established' is worth stating as a finding, i.e. the undated null does positive work in the argument rather than merely marking a gap.

premises: Limb (a), the FBI inconclusive, blocks the exculpatory reading from travelling.
Limb (b), the 'did not touch' testimony, makes the exclusion prove little either way.
Each limb has its own limits, which cut back the other way.

chain_name: P8: from 27 matching rebuilds to "the numbers are right and the scopes slip" — and out to the whole library

steps.step: S1 — Thirty load-bearing quantities rebuilt under isolation
premises: On 2026-09-14 thirty quantities described as load-bearing were selected out of this document.
Agents who were not shown the document, and were instructed not to open it, were asked what the record states for each quantity.
No check question contained its own answer, and comparison against the document happened only afterwards.

steps.conclusion: Independent reconstruction from source agreed with the value this document prints for all but one of the thirty quantities checked.

'Load-bearing' is a criterion applied before selection rather than a label attached afterwards.

steps.step: S2 — Iteration 2: 82 further quantities by redaction slot, zero contradictions

A quantity that also appears elsewhere in this document, or in a sibling library file an agent could reach, was not recovered by that route and then scored as an independent rebuild.
'Agreeing with this file' was scored against the withheld true value, not against the agent's answer merely being plausible.
The 3 harness failures are non-informative rather than concentrated on the hardest items.
The 7 correctly-flagged ambiguous/second-hand items count as successes of the checking method rather than as defects in the document's own scoping.
Agreement rates from iteration 1's question method and iteration 2's redaction method are commensurable enough to be reported as one improving trend (one-in-thirty → zero-in-82).

steps.step: S3 — The denominator re-census, and the exhaustion claim
premises: An earlier statement that 163 quantities had never been rebuilt came from a loose census that counted section cross-references and revision-log timestamps.

Every one of the 113 excluded sentences is genuinely about this project's editing rather than about the case, and none of them carries a case-relevant figure.
'Checkable against a court record' is the right test of whether a number needs verifying — a number with no court record behind it cannot be wrong in a way that matters.
The first census being wrong is not itself a reason to treat the second as provisional.
Exhausting the quantities exhausts what P8 exists to test, so 'EXHAUSTED' is a property of the protocol's job and not only of one list.

steps.step: S4 — The residue is scope, not value
premises: Rows that returned supported values still carry warnings about how those values are framed: a capped statistic read as a measurement; item designators read as physical swabs; a numerator with no stated denominator; file lines read as transcript lines; a document's length confused with a rule about document length; four campus entries collapsed into one.
Only one quantity of the thirty was contradicted.

implicit_premises: The scope caveats are themselves correct — but the isolated agents were asked only what the record states for each value, so these caveats were produced on the drafting side and were not independently checked by this protocol.
Six named scope failures support the word 'frequently', although no count of scope statements checked and found sound is given, so the claim has no denominator.
The scope failures found are the scope failures present — an audit aimed at values reliably surfaces framing errors as a by-product.
A wrong scope and a wrong number are commensurable enough to be traded against each other in a single summary verdict.
The six named failures are of one kind ('scope') rather than a set of separately-caused errors grouped after the fact under one word.

steps.step: S5 — But zero contradictions is evidence about the quantities, not about the document
premises: P3 and P5 continued to find defects in the same passages whose numbers verified in this pass.
steps.conclusion: The clean quantity result must be read as evidence about the quantities and not as evidence that the document is sound.
implicit_premises: The passages P3 and P5 faulted and the sentences whose numbers P8 rebuilt are substantially the same passages, rather than different sentences being treated as one set.
A protocol's result carries no transfer to any property it did not test — which, applied evenly, would also bar reading this pass's scope findings (S4) as a verdict on the document.
Defects found by other protocols in the same passage are compatible with, rather than evidence against, the value in that passage being right.

steps.step: S6 — Four protocols, four methods, one pathology
premises: P9 found that quotation drift was compression rather than invention, that it ran in one direction — toward a firmer, cleaner claim than the speaker made — and reported that as the same finding in a different medium: the anchors are sound and the scopes slip.
P3's failure distribution is led by scope-widening (46), nulls doing positive work (18) and self-certification (8).

steps.conclusion: Four protocols using four methods converged on one pathology in this document.

Failure categories defined separately by each protocol map onto one another closely enough that 'the same three failures' is an identity and not a family resemblance.
Convergence on a failure class is evidence about the document rather than about a shared assumption in how the four checks were designed.
P3's rate figures are usable here even though the same section says a high invalid rate is partly an artifact of the deductive standard.

steps.step: S7 — And out to the whole library
premises: This library's earlier work on the DNA evidence found that the checkable anchors — which item, which laboratory, which magnitude — are almost all verifiable and were reported approximately right, while the interpretive connections asserted between them are where the record and the public accounts diverge, and diverge in one direction, toward source attribution.

The DNA and Owens findings are established independently of this document, so the agreement is corroboration rather than one author framing three bodies of material the same way.
Three cases sharing a description are enough to generalise to the library as a whole.

A finding about how this library's own sentences were scoped can be stated in the same breath as a finding about how outside claimants argued, without the two being different kinds of claim.

chain_name: Thirteen ratio-bearing ATF items — and why 'two' is a floor on State's Exhibit 33, not its content
section: §8.2 (scope block and calc table), carried into §8.4 item 4, §8.6 limit 3, §ES findings 4 and 7, §15 rows 8–9, and §17's drift table
